description: Activate when: someone says 'things always bounce back,' wonders why an intervention seemed to work on a struggling team, is surprised their star performer regressed, is evaluating whether a coaching/bonus/firing had an effect, or is interpreting before-vs-after performance changes without a control group. Do NOT activate when: the measurement is genuinely noise-free (e.g., deterministic process outputs); the underlying signal has demonstrably changed due to a structural shift (new product launch, technology change). More: deciqai.com/c/regression-to-the-mean
